::: {.callout-note}
## Working research proposition
A 1990 ECPM skill-development manual is cited in a later public bibliography. A possible 1994 training revision remains unverified. *Keys on Freedom* remains unconfirmed outside the commissioning issue. This page does not assert how those items relate to each other or to CSIL.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can define ECPM from recovered manuals and contemporaneous records, and can test later claims that ECPM sits between Creekview and individualized CSIL funding.

## Evidence status

- **Bibliographically confirmed (copy sought):** [ECPM *Skill Development Manual*](../sources/wanted-ecpm-manuals.qmd) (BC Rehab & Greater Vancouver Home Support Society, 1990) as cited in the [Roeher / Salisbury bibliography](../sources/allenshea-1997-if-bibliography.qmd).
- **Later attribution, not a manual:** [IFRC Our Team](../sources/ifrc-our-team.qmd) calls ECPM “the individual funding project” preceding CSIL.
- **Not independently confirmed:** [*Keys on Freedom*](../sources/wanted-keys-on-freedom.qmd).
- **Open questions:** how many distinct ECPM publications exist; whether a 1994 item is a revision, a training manual, or a different work; whether Emma Van der Klift appears on any title page (not found on inspected public items).
